source_text: Anecdotal reports from adults who underwent low and tight circumcisions—a style removing more inner foreskin, resulting in a tight appearance and scar close to the glans—often describe reduced penile sensitivity, less intense sexual pleasure compared to uncircumcised states or other styles (e.g., high and loose), needing more stimulation for orgasm, and regrets due to perceived loss of fine-touch sensation from removed sensitive tissue.
